title: Puzzle switch-over timeline
description: A centred two-line headline, a short paragraph and two buttons (dark with arrow, outline with an icon), then a three-step timeline — white pills over a thin line with small dots, the current step outlined and dotted in violet — and three hairline-bordered cards with a title and a bulleted list; the middle card ends in a full-bleed photo frame. On phones the buttons go full width, the timeline hides and the cards stack.
notes: a card with withMedia shows its media (or a placeholder) flush with its bottom edge
name: puzzle-migrate

props.name: actions
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon?: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: the first is dark with an arrow, the second outlined; icon is a small lucide icon

props.name: steps
props.description: the timeline's labels (three read best); hidden on phones

props.name: activeStep
props.description: which step is current, counting from 0
